messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High error rate + latency spike on /v1/generate (kv-cache/continuous-batching). Pager fired and oncall notified. Incident ID INC-2026-045. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-incident
oncall-alex: ack — I'm on it. What's the initial impact surface? any customers showing obvious failures?
observability-bot: Metrics snapshot (11:12-11:32 UTC): 5xx up 0.2% -> 18%, p95 latency 120ms -> 960ms, token-per-request batching rate x3, KV-cache per-shard size increased from ~2GB -> ~9GB on a subset of shards. Dash: https://dashboards/redwood/kv-cache/INC-2026-045
eng-runtime-sam: digging in logs. Seeing cache blowups where a few TP shards own 60-70% of keys, causing repeated repopulation and NCCL stalls. Errors in gpu logs: ```
E NCCL: Unhandled system error (ncclCommSynchronize failed): 0x3
W KVCache: shard 4 overflow, evict loop triggered, repopulate from disk...
I Batching: continuous_batcher coalesced 24 requests -> 1 batch; latency spiked
```
eng-ml-raj: FYI we rolled continuous-batching v2 + tensor-shard-map change ~T-2h in the last deploy. I suspect an accidental change in the tensor_shard_map() hash that skewed partitioning. If shards are uneven, some GPUs get hot and NCCL sync waits.
infra-maya: initial mitigation proposal: 1) disable continuous-batching for the affected route; 2) set MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=2048 (down from 8192); 3) scale up dedicated pool by +2 GPUs for short term. I can push the config change now.
oncall-alex: doing the disable now via admin console and will post curl command for infra to keep as runbook snippet.
oncall-alex: ```
# disable continuous batching on route /v1/generate
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.internal/config/routes/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"continuous_batching":false, "max_batch_tokens":2048}'
```
observability-bot: 6m after mitigation: p95 down from 960ms -> 260ms, 5xx down to 2.3%, KB per-shard imbalance reduced (peak shard size ~3.1GB). NCCL warnings persist but no full stalls observed.
customer-success-luis: AcmeCorp reported 5 failed requests and higher latency between 11:18-11:40. They want a concise timeline and mitigation summary; flagged SSO ticket #CUST-1102.
ops-karen: please start an incident bridge and begin collecting impact timeline for customers. Assign owners: eng-runtime (root cause + hotfix), eng-ml (model/shard logic), infra (scaling + config).
eng-releases-zoe: prepping a hotfix branch now. Cherry-picking PR #4821 (revert tensor_shard_map change) + unit test. Plan: canary on dedicated pool in 30m, promote if stable. ETA 45m.
devex-li: we should add an alert for per-shard KV size > 5GB and NCCL stall rate > 0.5% to catch this earlier. I'll file the alert by EOD.
eng-runtime-sam: quick triage notes: root cause likely a logic regression in tensor_shard_map that changed key->shard mapping distribution under multi-GPU TP config. Combined with continuous-batching coalescing, that concentrated many prefixes into few shards, causing cache thrash and blocking NCCL syncs. Hotfix PR created: https://git.redwood/pulls/4850 (includes revert + deterministic shard test).
infra-maya: scaling + config patch applied. Observability shows downstream queue length reduced and evictions stopped.
eng-runtime-sam: rolling forward mitigation: keep continuous-batching disabled until PR 4850 lands and canary verifies. Postmortem will include telemetry to surface shard imbalance and a rollback guard in deploy pipeline.
ops-karen: customer communication: CS to send interim note to AcmeCorp with timeline and mitigation; legal/finance to note potential SLA window.
eng-releases-zoe: will coordinate canary and provide a deployment timeline in #eng-releases. Hotfix ETA 45m -> canary start.
observability-bot: Final snapshot at 11:38 UTC: p95=240ms, 5xx=1.9%, KV per-shard median 2.6GB, max shard 3.4GB. No further NCCL errors in logs after 11:33 UTC.
eng-ml-raj: we'll add deterministic mapping tests and a fuzz test for shard distribution. Also adding a safety cap in tensor_shard_map to avoid extreme skew.
customer-success-luis: logged customer impact and sent interim incident note. They asked for a follow-up postmortem and ETA for permanent fix.
ops-karen: assigning postmortem: eng-runtime-sam (lead), eng-ml-raj (cause), infra-maya (mitigation), devex-li (alerts). Please include timeline, RCA, and remediation actions.
eng-runtime-sam: noted. I'll prepare the RCA and include perf graphs + a diff of the shard distribution before/after. Will attach PR 4850 link and plan for staged rollout.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 mitigated at 1850002722 (mitigated, severity: sev-2). Postmortem requested in 24h. If re-open needed, react with :rotating_light: and the oncall will be paged.
